text_blocks.snippet: For US citizens traveling to the UK, an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) is now required before travel. This requirement is in effect for visits up to six months for tourism, business, or family visits. You can apply for an ETA through the UK ETA website or mobile app, and it's electronically linked to your passport.
snippet_highlighted_words: an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) is now required before travel

list.snippet: Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA): US citizens need an ETA for visits to the UK, including transit through UK airports.
Valid Passport: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.
Application Process: Apply for the ETA through the official UK government website or mobile app.
Fees: The ETA costs £16 per application.
Validity: The ETA is valid for two years or until your passport expires, whichever comes first.
Purpose of Visit: The ETA allows visits for up to six months for tourism, business, short-term study, or visiting friends/family.
No COVID-19 Restrictions: You do not need to show proof of vaccination or take COVID-19 tests when entering the UK, according to GOV.UK.
Apply for an ETA: Complete the application well in advance of your departure.
Check your passport: Ensure your passport is valid for the entire trip.
Confirm eligibility: Ensure you meet the requirements for the ETA, according to the U.S. Embassy in Switzerland and Liechtenstein (.gov).
Prepare for potential checks: Be prepared to show your passport and ETA at the border.

text_blocks.snippet: In summary, US citizens need an ETA for UK travel, which can be obtained through the official UK government website. It's crucial to apply in advance and have a valid passport for your entire trip.
